User "" on computer "" is currently working on Document
![[Pasted image 20241231123925.png]]

Likely problem is the session is being hosted on multiple servers making CaseWare think the file is open in more than one place.

First thing to try is to log them off completely:

- In Director, find the user and go to the 'Activity Manager'
- On the session details drop down, select log off

![](data:image/png;base64,)

If this doesn't work, may need to reboot the server the machine is hosted on.
***Note: This will kick everyone off the server. Comms need to be sent to the users.**

- Ensure the user with the issue is logged out completely of their session.
- Send comms to all the users by going to the server and clicking the "no of sessions"

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- ensure all the boxes are ticked.
![[Pasted image 20241231124029.png]]

- Give them 5 mins to save their work and log out.
- If there is an error, you have to message all the users in Teams individually.
- Put the server into maintenance mode so no one else can log onto the server.
    - Select the server and click maintenance mode

![[Pasted image 20241231124100.png]]

- After the 5 mins, hit power control and Force Restart

![](data:image/png;base64,)
